title: Add an accessibility label to RewardConfigHeader's icon-only back button
why: The back-navigation IconButton has no `tooltip` and the Icon has no semanticLabel, so a screen-reader user (TalkBack/VoiceOver) reaches this control with no announced purpose — unlike the adjacent PopupMenuButton, which gets a Flutter-provided default tooltip. This is a real, checkable AX-3 gap on a primary navigation control in a screen a parent (potentially using assistive tech) uses to configure rewards.
recommendation: Add tooltip: AppLocalizations.of(context)!.<backButtonLabel> (or reuse MaterialLocalizations back-button semantics) to the IconButton.
acceptance_criteria: A widget test finds a Semantics node with a non-empty label for the back button via find.bySemanticsLabel or tester.getSemantics.
